criticalFindings: Term 1 MCQ answer keys are heavily biased to option A in most learning areas; several areas have all 80 answers at index 0.
Term 1 structured banks contain generic placeholder patterns, especially definition/importance/procedure/safety/uses/challenge prompts mechanically generated from broad topic words.
Term 2 and Term 3 batch drafts are identical question-for-question for the same areas; they cannot be counted as independent term coverage.
Term 2 and Term 3 drafts each contain only 5 MCQs and 2 structured questions per area and omit Mathematics.
The existing Term 1 structured counts include 121 in CRE and Integrated Science, so totals are 2,002 rather than exactly 2,000; remove or reclassify extras after review.
releaseDecision: Do not merge or publish these banks as complete. Keep all draft material isolated until source alignment, answer-key balancing, duplicate review, marking-guide review and validator pass.
